d:
A massive winged demonic entity with jagged charcoal-grey skin and glowing magma veins. The head is a horned skull-like visage with glowing molten-orange eyes and no visible nose. A colossal deep-crimson blade is fused into the right arm, with large tattered bat-like wings sprouting from the back and a thick pointed tail. Four sharp claws on each hand.
BODY COLOR: charcoal-grey
